title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the Pro elementor.pro.loop.create_item tool
_comment: WP-R10 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness.md §8; 13-tool-catalog.md §1.8). elementor.pro.loop.create_item is MUTATING (class M, side proxied-to-REST: POST elementor-ultra/v1/pro/loop/item — PHP Loop_Service documents->create('loop-item',{post_title,post_status})). It is a NON-★ Pro tool, so the lean profile registers it DISABLED at boot; the smoke driver must enable it (tools.search 'elementor.pro.loop') before invoking. It CREATES a NEW loop-item template doc, so it does not touch any shared disposable draft; the driver trashes the created template_id in teardown. Gated on `requires.pro:true` so a free-only install SKIPS rather than fails (the PHP route returns 501 PRO_REQUIRED otherwise → mapped to an isError, never a -326xx). MINIMAL valid input per §1.8: REQUIRED {title}; elements is optional and omitted. The §8 suite asserts no protocol error (-326xx) and a result matching the outputSchema {template_id, edit_url}.
